harness_fidelity.interpretation: Cross-code-path re-evaluation matches Phase 2 to 3.5e-4 = 0.035%. This exceeds Phase 2 intra-run reproducibility (3.4e-5) by ~10x, consistent with FP32 CUDA non-determinism and different batch accumulation orders. The harness is functionally identical to Phase 2. All SC-FNO variants evaluated with this harness, so cross-variant comparisons are valid.
